\mxunit{enrichment-inequalities-exercises}{Inequalities and equality cases}
\mxsubtitle{High school · optimisation and olympiads \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 11}

\begin{exercise}
For $x>0$, prove $x+\frac{1}{x}\geq 2$ and determine equality.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Find the minimum of $x^{2}-6x+13$ on $\R $.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
A rectangle has perimeter 24 m. What is its greatest area?
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
For real a,b, prove $a^{2}+b^{2}\geq 2ab$. Must a and b be positive?
\end{exercise}
